title: Computational functionalism is adopted as a working hypothesis

statements.text: The report adopts computational functionalism, the thesis that performing computations of the right kind is necessary and sufficient for consciousness, as a working hypothesis. It is a mainstream though disputed position. The reasons are pragmatic: unlike its rivals it entails that AI consciousness is possible in principle and that the workings of AI systems bear on whether they are conscious. The authors differ in confidence but agree that the thesis is plausible.
